requirement.clarified: Fix the CSS regression introduced in task 20260517-172103: (1) .slot-selected timeline cards must use a horizontal flex layout (photo 120x80 left, text right) instead of full-width block photo stacking; (2) #trip-cover must be removed or constrained to max-height 200px with object-position: top. CSS-only fix. No JS changes.
requirement.what: Scoped CSS override for .slot-selected photo layout + fix #trip-cover aspect-ratio/visibility
requirement.why: Prior photo cycle introduced global .card-photo rule that renders 712x401px hero images in the timeline, making each slot card ~586px tall — a regression from the prior design that matches neither the published fixed page nor any upgrade of it

included: .slot-selected .card-photo scoped override: width 120px, height 80px, aspect-ratio auto, flex-shrink 0
#trip-cover: add hidden attribute to HTML element; update CSS to 16/9 + max-height 200px + object-position top
excluded: Global .card-photo rule — must not change (sidebar depends on it)
Any token, color, font, grid layout change

success_criteria: div.slot-selected renders as flex row: photo left, text right
Total height of .slot-selected with photo is <= 150px
Candidate sidebar card photos are unaffected (offsetWidth >= 200px)
#trip-cover is either hidden or renders at offsetHeight <= 200px with object-position top
constraints: Must not break candidate sidebar card photo sizing
Must not change any global rule that other components depend on

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Timeline slot selected cards render photos as full-width 16:9 hero images (~712x401px at 1440px layout) making each slot card ~586px tall
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: The global CSS rule `.card-photo { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16/9; }` was added without a scoped override for the `.slot-selected` context. Inside `.slot-selected { display: block; }`, the img inherits `width: 100%` relative to the ~712px middle pane, rendering at 712x401px. The candidate sidebar cards (300px wide) correctly show ~235px photos because the sidebar pane is narrower — but the middle pane is ~712px, so the same rule produces a drastically larger image.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: 7b416587 — feat(web): 3-column Notion layout — Days | Timeline+Dashboard | Candidates (includes photo CSS from 20260517-172103)
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: BA spec 20260517-172103 correctly specified `.card-photo` as a shared rule to cover both sidebar and timeline contexts, but did not specify that the two contexts need different sizing because the middle pane is ~2.4x wider than the sidebar
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: No scoped override constrains `.card-photo` when it appears inside `.slot-selected`. The block layout stacks the 712x401 image above the text, making each card ~586px tall and the full timeline ~4000px+ of hero images
observations: state.js:500-525: _writeSlotSelected() appends img, nameDiv, metaDiv as sequential children of selEl (inferred from Read)
root_cause_analysis.diagnosis_completeness: incomplete (inferred only — no live browser measurement taken; runtime observation would confirm pixel dimensions but the CSS arithmetic is deterministic: 100% of ~712px middle pane = ~712px)
root_cause_analysis.localization_evidence: Read of main.css:407-434 and state.js:500-525 shows the selector structure. The defect is deterministic from CSS arithmetic: .card-photo width:100% inside a ~712px container = 712px image. No ambiguity requiring runtime measurement.

novelty_check.rationale: Prior attempt applied a global rule uniformly. This attempt adds a SCOPED .slot-selected .card-photo override with higher specificity (0-2-0 vs 0-1-0) that constrains only the timeline context. The mechanism (CSS scope) is different from the prior attempt's mechanism (single global rule). Same CSS layer but a different and correct approach: context differentiation via CSS specificity.
